Predicates:
NLPTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
GenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
UnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: The output of x is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Conclusion:
MachineTranslation(x) → GenerationTask(x) ::: If x is machine translation, then it is a language generation task.
